<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Saken Chef</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,500;0,9..144,700;1,9..144,600&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<style>
:root{
--bg: #0C0C0D;
--bg-2: #1D1310;
--card: #FFFBF5;
--ink: #221A12;
--ink-soft: #6b5a48;
--chalk: #F3EDE4;
--chalk-dim: #b4a99c;
--gold: #FFB347;
--red: #FF6A1A;
--sage: #8a7f74;
--line: rgba(255,178,80,0.14);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
body{
margin:0;
background:
radial-gradient(circle at 18% 8%, rgba(255,122,26,0.22), transparent 32%),
radial-gradient(circle at 82% 4%, rgba(255,106,26,0.14), transparent 34%),
radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(255,106,26,0.10), transparent 45%),
repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 42px),
repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 42px),
linear-gradient(180deg, #0c0c0d, #171110 55%, #0c0c0d);
background-color:#0c0c0d;
color:var(--chalk);
font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
min-height:100vh;
padding-bottom:60px;
}
.wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 18px 0;}
header.top{text-align:center;margin-bottom:22px;}
.logo-badge{margin:0 auto 10px;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(255,106,26,0.35));}
.eyebrow{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
letter-spacing:.18em;
text-transform:uppercase;
font-size:11px;
color:var(--gold);
margin-bottom:8px;
}
h1{
font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
font-weight:700;
font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,46px);
margin:0 0 6px;
line-height:1.05;
letter-spacing:.01em;
}
.sub{color:var(--chalk-dim);font-size:14.5px;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;}
.weeklabel{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:13px;
color:var(--gold);
margin-top:10px;
}
nav.rail{
display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;
margin:26px 0 22px;
}
.tab{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:12px;
letter-spacing:.03em;
background:var(--bg-2);
color:var(--chalk-dim);
border:1px solid var(--line);
border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;
padding:9px 14px 8px;
cursor:pointer;
position:relative;
top:1px;
}
.tab:hover{color:var(--chalk);}
.tab.active{
background:var(--card);
color:var(--ink);
border-color:var(--card);
font-weight:700;
}
.ticket{
background:var(--card);
color:var(--ink);
border-radius:6px;
padding:26px 24px;
margin-bottom:22px;
position:relative;
box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.28);
}
.ticket::before,.ticket::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;
width:16px;height:16px;
background:var(--bg);
border-radius:50%;
top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
}
.ticket::before{left:-8px;}
.ticket::after{right:-8px;}
.ticket h2{
font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
font-size:22px;
margin:0 0 4px;
}
.ticket .desc{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:18px;}
label{
display:block;
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:11px;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.06em;
color:var(--ink-soft);
margin-bottom:6px;
margin-top:16px;
}
input[type=text], textarea, select{
width:100%;
font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
font-size:15px;
padding:10px 12px;
border:1.5px solid #ddd6c4;
border-radius:4px;
background:#fff;
color:var(--ink);
}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:90px;font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;}
button{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:13px;
letter-spacing:.03em;
text-transform:uppercase;
border:none;
border-radius:4px;
padding:11px 18px;
cursor:pointer;
font-weight:700;
transition:transform .08s ease;
}
button:active{transform:scale(0.97);}
.btn-primary{background:var(--red);color:var(--card);}
.btn-primary:hover{background:#992f24;}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2a06;}
.btn-gold:hover{background:#c4941f;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft);border:1.5px solid #ddd6c4;}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ink-soft);color:var(--ink);}
.btn-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;}
.role-grid{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:10px;}
.role-opt{
border:1.5px solid #ddd6c4;
border-radius:5px;
padding:14px;
cursor:pointer;
}
.role-opt:hover{border-color:var(--red);}
.role-opt b{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:16px;}
.role-opt span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.pill{
display:inline-block;
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:11px;
padding:3px 9px;
border-radius:20px;
background:var(--sage);
color:#10160f;
font-weight:700;
}
.pill.red{background:var(--red);color:#fff;}
.pill.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2a06;}
.rank-cat{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px dashed #ddd6c4;padding-top:14px;}
.rank-cat h4{
font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
font-size:15px;
margin:0 0 10px;
}
.rank-row{
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
background:#fff;
border:1px solid #ece5d3;
border-radius:4px;
padding:8px 10px;
margin-bottom:6px;
}
.rank-num{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-weight:700;
color:var(--red);
width:22px;
}
.rank-name{flex:1;font-size:14px;}
.rank-arrows{display:flex;gap:4px;}
.arrow-btn{
background:#f1ecdd;color:var(--ink);
border:none;border-radius:3px;
width:26px;height:26px;
font-size:13px;line-height:1;
padding:0;cursor:pointer;
}
.arrow-btn:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default;}
table.score{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;}
table.score th{
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;
text-align:left;color:var(--ink-soft);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink);
padding:6px 6px;
}
table.score td{padding:7px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ece5d3;}
table.score tr.winner td{font-weight:700;}
.stamp{
display:inline-block;
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:9.5px;
font-weight:700;
color:var(--gold);
border:1.5px solid var(--gold);
border-radius:3px;
padding:1px 6px;
transform:rotate(-4deg);
margin-left:6px;
}
.progress-line{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:6px;}
.muted{color:var(--chalk-dim);font-size:13px;}
.empty{
text-align:center;padding:30px 10px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;
}
.name-screen{
max-width:380px;margin:80px auto;text-align:center;
}
.who{
position:fixed;top:12px;right:14px;
font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
font-size:11px;color:var(--chalk-dim);
background:rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;
}
.cat-list-input{margin-top:8px;}
.cat-line{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.cat-line input{flex:1;}
.small-x{
background:transparent;color:var(--red);border:none;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 6px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div>
<script>
/* ---------- Conexión a Supabase ---------- */
/* 1) Ve a tu proyecto de Supabase > Settings > API
2) Copia "Project URL" y pégalo en SUPABASE_URL
3) Copia la clave "anon public" y pégala en SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
4) Ejecuta antes el script supabase_setup.sql en el SQL Editor de Supabase */
const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://jxtcpupamgdueqpkxemo.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Imp4dGNwdXBhbWdkdWVxcGt4ZW1vIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODUwNTg4MDIsImV4cCI6MjEwMDYzNDgwMn0.U4ohgrJJlC-JsMIyyaYKjix9fBvEw-oRteKQmtVq1x4';
const sb = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
/* Mini capa de compatibilidad: mismo "get/set/delete" que usaba window.storage,
pero guardando en la tabla kv_store de Supabase en vez de en memoria de Claude. */
const storage = {
async get(key){
try{
const { data, error } = await sb.from('kv_store').select('value').eq('key', key).maybeSingle();
if(error){ console.error('storage.get error:', JSON.stringify(error, null, 2)); return { key, value: null, error }; }
return data ? { key, value: JSON.stringify(data.value) } : null;
}catch(e){ console.error('storage.get threw:', e); return { key, value: null, error: e }; }
},
async set(key, value){
try{
const { error } = await sb.from('kv_store').upsert({ key, value: JSON.parse(value), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() });
if(error){ console.error('storage.set error:', JSON.stringify(error, null, 2)); return { key, value, error }; }
return { key, value };
}catch(e){ console.error('storage.set threw:', e); return { key, value, error: e }; }
},
async delete(key){
try{
const { error } = await sb.from('kv_store').delete().eq('key', key);
if(error){ console.error('storage.delete error:', JSON.stringify(error, null, 2)); return { key, deleted:false, error }; }
return { key, deleted: true };
}catch(e){ console.error('storage.delete threw:', e); return { key, deleted:false, error: e }; }
}
};
/* Muestra el error real de Supabase en pantalla (una sola vez, no en cada sondeo). */
let lastStorageErrorMsg = null;
function reportStorageError(err){
const msg = (err && (err.message || err.details || err.hint)) || JSON.stringify(err);
if(msg === lastStorageErrorMsg) return;
lastStorageErrorMsg = msg;
flash('Error de Supabase: ' + msg);
}
function clearStorageError(){ lastStorageErrorMsg = null; }
/* ---------- Estado ---------- */
const S = {
user: null,
contest: null,
history: [],
draft: {}, // draft[dishId][category] = [names ordered mejor->peor]
editingDish: null, // dishId being edited/voted right now
tab: 'inicio',
isAdmin: false,
loaded:false,
flash: null, // {text, type}
confirmReset: false,
confirmClose: false
};
const CATS_DEFAULT = ["Presentación","Sabor","Sal","Textura"];
/* Emblema original (corona de llamas + "S"), inspirado en la estética de
concursos de cocina, sin copiar ningún logo de marca registrada. */
const LOGO_SVG = `
<svg class="logo-badge" width="76" height="76" viewBox="0 0 120 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<linearGradient id="flameGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFC978"/>
<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF6A1A"/>
</linearGradient>
</defs>
<g>
<path id="flameShape" d="M60 3 C67 16 71 23 65 31 C62 35 58 35 55 31 C49 23 53 16 60 3 Z" fill="url(#flameGrad)"/>
<use href="#flameShape" transform="rotate(30 60 60)"/>
<use href="#flameShape" transform="rotate(60 60 60)"/>
<use href="#flameShape" transform="rotate(90 60 60)"/>
<use href="#flameShape" transform="rotate(120 60 60)"/>
<use href="#flameShape" transform="rotate(150 60 60)"/>

/* Cambia este PIN para controlar quién puede crear/gestionar el concurso. */
const ADMIN_PIN = 'SAKENCHEF';
/* ---------- Storage helpers ---------- */
async function getContest(){
try{
const r = await storage.get('contest');
if(r && r.error){ reportStorageError(r.error); return null; }
clearStorageError();
return r ? JSON.parse(r.value) : null;
}catch(e){ reportStorageError(e); return null; }
}
async function saveContest(c){
const r = await storage.set('contest', JSON.stringify(c));
if(r && r.error){ reportStorageError(r.error); return; }
clearStorageError();
S.contest = c;
}
async function getHistory(){
try{
const r = await storage.get('history');
if(r && r.error){ reportStorageError(r.error); return []; }
return r ? JSON.parse(r.value) : [];
}catch(e){ reportStorageError(e); return []; }
}
async function saveHistory(h){
const r = await storage.set('history', JSON.stringify(h));
if(r && r.error){ reportStorageError(r.error); return; }
S.history = h;
}
async function refresh(){
const activeTag = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName;
if(activeTag === 'INPUT' || activeTag === 'TEXTAREA' || activeTag === 'SELECT'){
return; // no interrumpir mientras alguien está escribiendo o eligiendo algo
}
const c = await getContest();
S.contest = c;
S.loaded = true;
render();
}
function checkPin(pin){
if((pin||'').trim() === ADMIN_PIN){
S.isAdmin = true;
S.flash = null;
render();
} else {
flash('PIN incorrecto.');
}
}
function lockAdmin(){
S.isAdmin = false;
if(S.tab==='admin') S.tab = 'inicio';
render();
}
function flash(text, type='error'){
S.flash = { text, type };
render();
}
function dismissFlash(){
S.flash = null;
render();
}
/* ---------- Acciones ---------- */
let pollTimer = null;
async function setUser(name){
name = (name||'').trim();
if(!name) return;
S.user = name;
S.isAdmin = false;
refresh();
if(pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
pollTimer = setInterval(refresh, 6000);
}
function logoutUser(){
if(pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
S.user = null;
S.isAdmin = false;
S.tab = 'inicio';
S.editingDish = null;
S.draft = {};
S.flash = null;
render();
}
function goHome(){
S.tab = 'inicio';
S.editingDish = null;
S.flash = null;
render();
}
async function createWeek(dish1, dish2, cats1, cats2, dateStr){
if(!S.isAdmin){ flash('Solo la administradora puede crear el concurso.'); return; }
dish1 = dish1.trim(); dish2 = dish2.trim();
cats1 = cats1.map(c=>c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
cats2 = cats2.map(c=>c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
if(!dish1 || !dish2 || cats1.length===0 || cats2.length===0){ flash('Rellena ambos platos y al menos una categoría para cada uno.'); return; }
const finalDate = dateStr || todayIso();
const contest = {
date: finalDate,
weekLabel: 'Concurso del ' + formatDateEs(finalDate),
dishes: [
{id:'d1', name:dish1, categories:cats1},
{id:'d2', name:dish2, categories:cats2}
],
participants: {},
votes: {}
};
await saveContest(contest);
render();
}
/* Categorías de un plato, con compatibilidad hacia versiones antiguas que
guardaban una única lista de categorías compartida (c.categories). */
function dishCategories(dish, c){
if(dish && dish.categories && dish.categories.length) return dish.categories;
if(c && c.categories && c.categories.length) return c.categories;
return CATS_DEFAULT;
}
function todayIso(){ return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function formatDateEs(dateStr){
if(!dateStr) return '';
const [y,m,d] = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
const dt = new Date(y, m-1, d);
return dt.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric'});
}
async function registerRole(role, dishId){
const c = S.contest;
c.participants[S.user] = { role, dishId: role==='cook' ? dishId : null };
await saveContest(c);
render();
}
async function clearMyRole(){
const c = S.contest;
delete c.participants[S.user];
await saveContest(c);
render();
}
async function adminAddParticipant(name, roleValue){
name = (name||'').trim();
if(!name){ flash('Escribe un nombre.'); return; }
const c = S.contest;
if(c.participants[name]){ flash('Ya hay un participante con ese nombre.'); return; }
let role, dishId;
if(roleValue === 'eater'){ role='eater'; dishId=null; }
else { role='cook'; dishId = roleValue.split(':')[1]; }
c.participants[name] = { role, dishId };
await saveContest(c);
flash('Participante añadido.', 'info');
}
async function adminRemoveParticipant(name){
const c = S.contest;
delete c.participants[name];
delete c.votes[name];
await saveContest(c);
flash('Participante eliminado (y sus votos, si había emitido alguno).', 'info');
}
function dishEntries(c, dishId){
return Object.entries(c.participants)
.filter(([n,p])=> p.role==='cook' && p.dishId===dishId)
.map(([n])=>n);
}
/* Códigos anónimos por plato: "<nombre del plato> 1", "<nombre del plato> 2"...
El orden es el orden en que la gente se apuntó a cocinar ese plato. */
function anonMapFor(entries, dish){
const map = {};
entries.forEach((name, idx)=> map[name] = `${dish.name} ${idx+1}`);
return map;
}
function dishesToVote(c){
const me = c.participants[S.user];
if(!me) return [];
return c.dishes.filter(d=>{
const entries = dishEntries(c, d.id);
if(entries.length===0) return false;
if(me.role==='cook' && me.dishId===d.id) return false;
return true;
});
}
function startVote(dishId){
const c = S.contest;
const dish = c.dishes.find(x=>x.id===dishId);
const cats = dishCategories(dish, c);
const entries = dishEntries(c, dishId);
const existing = (c.votes[S.user] && c.votes[S.user][dishId]) || null;
const draft = {};
cats.forEach(cat=>{
if(existing && existing[cat] && existing[cat].every(n=>entries.includes(n))){
draft[cat] = existing[cat].slice();
} else {
draft[cat] = entries.slice();
}
});
S.draft[dishId] = draft;
S.editingDish = dishId;
render();
}
function cancelVote(){
S.editingDish = null;
render();
}
function moveEntry(dishId, cat, idx, dir){
const arr = S.draft[dishId][cat];
const j = idx + dir;
if(j<0 || j>=arr.length) return;
[arr[idx], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[idx]];
render();
}
async function submitVote(dishId){
const c = S.contest;
c.votes[S.user] = c.votes[S.user] || {};
c.votes[S.user][dishId] = S.draft[dishId];
await saveContest(c);
S.editingDish = null;
render();
}
function computeScores(c, dishId){
const dish = c.dishes.find(x=>x.id===dishId);
const cats = dishCategories(dish, c);
const entries = dishEntries(c, dishId);
const N = entries.length;
const totals = {};
entries.forEach(e=>{
totals[e] = { cat:{}, total:0 };
cats.forEach(cat=> totals[e].cat[cat]=0);
});
let voteCount = 0;
Object.entries(c.votes).forEach(([voter, byDish])=>{
const v = byDish[dishId];
if(!v) return;
voteCount++;
cats.forEach(cat=>{
const order = v[cat];
if(!order) return;
order.forEach((name, idx)=>{
if(totals[name]===undefined) return;
const points = N - idx;
totals[name].cat[cat] += points;
totals[name].total += points;
});
});
});
const expectedVoters = Object.entries(c.participants).filter(([n,p])=>{
if(p.role==='cook' && p.dishId===dishId) return false;
return true;
}).length;
return { entries, N, totals, voteCount, expectedVoters, cats };
}
function requestCloseWeek(){
if(!S.isAdmin){ flash('Solo la administradora puede cerrar la semana.'); return; }
S.confirmClose = true;
render();
}
function cancelCloseWeek(){
S.confirmClose = false;
render();
}
async function doCloseWeek(){
const h = await getHistory();
h.unshift(S.contest);
await saveHistory(h);
await storage.delete('contest');
S.contest = null;
S.confirmClose = false;
render();
}
function requestResetVotes(){
if(!S.isAdmin){ flash('Solo la administradora puede reiniciar el concurso.'); return; }
S.confirmReset = true;
render();
}
function cancelResetVotes(){
S.confirmReset = false;
render();
}
async function doResetVotes(){
const c = S.contest;
c.participants = {};
c.votes = {};
await saveContest(c);
S.confirmReset = false;
flash('Participantes y votos reiniciados. Los platos y categorías se mantienen.', 'info');
}
async function saveContestMeta(dish1, dish2, cats1, cats2, dateStr){
dish1 = dish1.trim(); dish2 = dish2.trim();
cats1 = cats1.map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
cats2 = cats2.map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
if(!dish1 || !dish2 || cats1.length===0 || cats2.length===0){ flash('Rellena ambos platos y al menos una categoría para cada uno.'); return; }
const c = S.contest;
c.dishes[0].name = dish1; c.dishes[0].categories = cats1;
c.dishes[1].name = dish2; c.dishes[1].categories = cats2;
if(dateStr){
c.date = dateStr;
c.weekLabel = 'Concurso del ' + formatDateEs(dateStr);
}
await saveContest(c);
flash('Platos, categorías y fecha actualizados.', 'info');
}
function setTab(t){ S.tab = t; render(); }
/* ---------- Render ---------- */
function render(){
const app = document.getElementById('app');
if(!S.user){
app.innerHTML = renderNameScreen();
bindNameScreen();
return;
}
if(!S.loaded){
app.innerHTML = `<div class="wrap"><div class="empty">Cargando…</div></div>`;
return;
}
if(S.tab==='admin' && !S.isAdmin) S.tab = 'inicio';
let html = `<div class="who">👤 ${escapeHtml(S.user)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span id="homeBtn" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;">🏠 Inicio</span> &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span id="logoutBtn" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;">Cambiar usuario</span></div><div class="wrap">`;
html += renderHeader();
if(S.flash){
html += `<div class="ticket" style="border:2px solid ${S.flash.type==='info'?'var(--sage)':'var(--red)'};">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
<span style="font-size:14px;">${escapeHtml(S.flash.text)}</span>
<span id="dismissFlashBtn" style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;">×</span>
</div>
</div>`;
}
html += renderTabs();
if(S.tab==='inicio') html += renderInicio();
if(S.tab==='panel') html += renderPanel();
if(S.tab==='votar') html += renderVotar();
if(S.tab==='resultados') html += renderResultados();
if(S.tab==='admin' && S.isAdmin) html += renderAdmin();
html += `</div>`;
app.innerHTML = html;
bindAppEvents();
}
function renderNameScreen(){
return `
<div class="name-screen">
${LOGO_SVG}
<div class="eyebrow">Concurso de cocina de oficina</div>
<h1 style="margin-bottom:14px;">SAKEN CHEF</h1>
<p class="sub" style="margin-bottom:20px;">Escribe tu nombre para entrar a la semana en curso.</p>
<input id="nameInput" type="text" placeholder="Tu nombre" style="text-align:center;">
<div class="btn-row" style="justify-content:center;">
<button class="btn-primary" id="nameBtn">Entrar</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
function bindNameScreen(){
const btn = document.getElementById('nameBtn');
const inp = document.getElementById('nameInput');
btn.onclick = ()=> setUser(inp.value);
inp.onkeydown = (e)=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') setUser(inp.value); };
inp.focus();
}
function renderHeader(){
return `
<header class="top">
${LOGO_SVG}
<div class="eyebrow">Concurso de cocina de oficina</div>
<h1>SAKEN CHEF</h1>
<p class="sub">Cocina, vota y descubre quién se lleva el delantal esta semana.</p>
${S.contest ? `<div class="weeklabel">${escapeHtml(S.contest.weekLabel)} · ${escapeHtml(S.contest.dishes[0].name)} vs ${escapeHtml(S.contest.dishes[1].name)}</div>` : ''}
</header>`;
}
function renderCreateContestForm(){
return `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>Crear el concurso de esta semana</h2>
<div class="desc">Elige el día del concurso, los dos platos y las categorías de puntuación de cada uno.</div>
<label>Día del concurso</label>
<input type="date" id="contestDate" value="${todayIso()}">
<label>Plato 1</label>
<input type="text" id="dish1" placeholder="Ej. Tortilla">
<label>Categorías del plato 1 (una por línea)</label>
<textarea id="cats1">${CATS_DEFAULT.join('\n')}</textarea>
<label>Plato 2</label>
<input type="text" id="dish2" placeholder="Ej. Guacamole">
<label>Categorías del plato 2 (una por línea)</label>
<textarea id="cats2">${CATS_DEFAULT.join('\n')}</textarea>
<div class="btn-row">
<button class="btn-primary" id="createBtn">Crear concurso</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
function adminGateHtml(){
if(S.isAdmin){
return `<div class="btn-row"><span class="pill gold">ADMINISTRADORA</span><button class="btn-ghost" id="lockAdminBtn">Salir del modo admin</button></div>`;
}
return `
<div class="btn-row" style="align-items:center;">
<input type="text" id="pinInput" placeholder="PIN de administradora" style="max-width:220px;">
<button class="btn-ghost" id="submitPinBtn">Entrar como admin</button>
</div>`;
}
function renderTabs(){
const tabs = [
['inicio','Inicio'],
['panel','Mi participación'],
['votar','Votar'],
['resultados','Resultados']
];
if(S.isAdmin) tabs.push(['admin','Admin']);
return `<nav class="rail">
${tabs.map(([id,label])=>`<div class="tab ${S.tab===id?'active':''}" data-tab="${id}">${label}</div>`).join('')}
</nav>`;
}
function renderInicio(){
const c = S.contest;
if(!c){
return `<div class="ticket">
<h2>Todavía no hay concurso esta semana</h2>
<div class="desc">${S.isAdmin ? 'Créalo desde la pestaña Admin: elige el día, los platos y las categorías.' : 'Espera a que la administradora lo cree, o entra con el PIN si eres tú.'}</div>
${adminGateHtml()}
</div>`;
}
const cats1 = dishCategories(c.dishes[0], c);
const cats2 = dishCategories(c.dishes[1], c);
let html = '';
html += `<div class="ticket">
<h2>${escapeHtml(c.weekLabel)}</h2>
<div class="desc">
${escapeHtml(c.dishes[0].name)} (${cats1.map(escapeHtml).join(', ')})<br>
${escapeHtml(c.dishes[1].name)} (${cats2.map(escapeHtml).join(', ')})
</div>
${adminGateHtml()}
</div>`;
const entries = Object.entries(c.participants);
html += `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>Quién participa</h2>
<div class="desc">${entries.length} persona${entries.length===1?'':'s'} registrada${entries.length===1?'':'s'} esta semana.</div>
${entries.length? `<ul style="padding-left:18px;">
${entries.map(([n,p])=>`<li style="margin-bottom:4px;">${escapeHtml(n)} — ${p.role==='cook' ? 'cocina '+escapeHtml(c.dishes.find(d=>d.id===p.dishId).name) : 'come y vota'}</li>`).join('')}
</ul>` : `<div class="empty">Nadie se ha registrado todavía.</div>`}
</div>`;
if(S.isAdmin){
html += `<div class="desc" style="text-align:center;">Reiniciar el concurso, editar platos/categorías/fecha y ver el detalle de votos están en la pestaña <b>Admin</b>.</div>`;
}
return html;
}
function renderPanel(){
const c = S.contest;
if(!c){
return `<div class="ticket"><div class="empty">Todavía no hay concurso esta semana. Vuelve cuando la administradora lo cree.</div></div>`;
}
const me = c.participants[S.user];
let html = '';
if(!me){
html += `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>¿Qué haces esta semana?</h2>
<div class="desc">Elige si cocinas (y qué plato) o si solo vas a comer y votar.</div>
<div class="role-grid">
<div class="role-opt" data-role="cook" data-dish="d1">
<b>Cocino — ${escapeHtml(c.dishes[0].name)}</b>
<span>Presentas tu versión de este plato.</span>
</div>
<div class="role-opt" data-role="cook" data-dish="d2">
<b>Cocino — ${escapeHtml(c.dishes[1].name)}</b>
<span>Presentas tu versión de este plato.</span>
</div>
<div class="role-opt" data-role="eater" data-dish="">
<b>Solo como</b>
<span>Puedes votar en ambos platos.</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>`;
} else {
const dishName = me.role==='cook' ? c.dishes.find(d=>d.id===me.dishId).name : null;
html += `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>Tu participación</h2>
<p style="font-size:15px;">
${me.role==='cook'
? `Cocinas <span class="pill red">${escapeHtml(dishName)}</span>`
: `Solo comes <span class="pill">puedes votar en todo</span>`}
</p>
<div class="desc" style="margin-top:10px;">Puedes votar en los platos que no has cocinado, desde la pestaña «Votar».</div>
<div class="btn-row">
<button class="btn-ghost" id="changeRoleBtn">Cambiar mi elección</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
return html;
}
function renderVotar(){
const c = S.contest;
if(!c){
return `<div class="ticket"><div class="empty">Todavía no hay concurso esta semana.</div></div>`;
}
const me = c.participants[S.user];
if(!me){
return `<div class="ticket"><div class="empty">Primero dinos qué haces esta semana en «Mi participación».</div></div>`;
}
const toVote = dishesToVote(c);
if(toVote.length===0){
return `<div class="ticket"><div class="empty">No tienes platos pendientes de votar (o todavía nadie se ha apuntado como cocinero).</div></div>`;
}
let html = '';
toVote.forEach(d=>{
const entries = dishEntries(c, d.id);
const map = anonMapFor(entries, d);
const already = c.votes[S.user] && c.votes[S.user][d.id];
if(S.editingDish === d.id){
html += renderVoteForm(d, entries);
} else {
html += `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>${escapeHtml(d.name)} ${already ? '<span class="pill">votado</span>' : ''}</h2>
<div class="desc">${entries.length} versione${entries.length===1?'':'s'} a catar: ${entries.map(n=>map[n]).join(', ')} (busca esos números en los platos de verdad).</div>
<div class="btn-row">
<button class="btn-primary" data-startvote="${d.id}">${already ? 'Editar mi voto' : 'Votar'}</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
});
return html;
}
function renderVoteForm(d, entries){
const draft = S.draft[d.id];
const cats = dishCategories(d, S.contest);
const map = anonMapFor(entries, d);
let html = `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>Votar — ${escapeHtml(d.name)}</h2>
<div class="desc">Ordena de mejor a peor en cada categoría por su número (no ves nombres: la cata es anónima). La primera posición se lleva ${entries.length} puntos, la última 1.</div>`;
cats.forEach(cat=>{
const arr = draft[cat];
html += `
<div class="rank-cat">
<h4>${escapeHtml(cat)}</h4>
${arr.map((name, idx)=>`
<div class="rank-row">
<div class="rank-num">${arr.length-idx}</div>
<div class="rank-name">${escapeHtml(map[name] || name)}</div>
<div class="rank-arrows">
<button class="arrow-btn" ${idx===0?'disabled':''} data-move="${d.id}|${escapeAttr(cat)}|${idx}|-1">↑</button>
<button class="arrow-btn" ${idx===arr.length-1?'disabled':''} data-move="${d.id}|${escapeAttr(cat)}|${idx}|1">↓</button>
</div>
</div>`).join('')}
</div>`;
});
html += `
<div class="btn-row">
<button class="btn-primary" data-submitvote="${d.id}">Guardar voto</button>
<button class="btn-ghost" id="cancelVoteBtn">Cancelar</button>
</div>
</div>`;
return html;
}
function renderResultados(){
const c = S.contest;
if(!c){
return `<div class="ticket"><div class="empty">Todavía no hay concurso esta semana.</div></div>`;
}
let html = '';
c.dishes.forEach(d=>{
const entries = dishEntries(c, d.id);
if(entries.length===0){
html += `<div class="ticket"><h2>${escapeHtml(d.name)}</h2><div class="empty">Todavía nadie se ha apuntado a cocinar este plato.</div></div>`;
return;
}
const { totals, voteCount, expectedVoters, N, cats } = computeScores(c, d.id);
const ranked = entries.slice().sort((a,b)=> totals[b].total - totals[a].total);
const topScore = ranked.length ? totals[ranked[0]].total : 0;
const map = anonMapFor(entries, d);
// ganador por categoría
const catWinners = {};
cats.forEach(cat=>{
let best = null, bestScore = -1;
entries.forEach(e=>{
if(totals[e].cat[cat] > bestScore){ bestScore = totals[e].cat[cat]; best = e; }
});
catWinners[cat] = best;
});
html += `
<div class="ticket">
<h2>${escapeHtml(d.name)}</h2>
<div class="progress-line">${voteCount}/${expectedVoters} votos recibidos · máx. ${N} pts por categoría · votación anónima por número</div>
<table class="score">
<thead><tr>
<th>Nº</th>
${cats.map(cat=>`<th>${escapeHtml(cat)}</th>`).join('')}
<th>Total</th>
</tr></thead>
<tbody>
${ranked.map(name=>`
<tr class="${totals[name].total===topScore && topScore>0 ? 'winner':''}">
<td>${escapeHtml(map[name])}${totals[name].total===topScore && topScore>0 ? ' <span class="stamp">GANADOR</span>':''}</td>
${cats.map(cat=>`<td>${totals[name].cat[cat]}${catWinners[cat]===name && totals[name].cat[cat]>0 ?' <span class="pill gold">mejor</span>':''}</td>`).join('')}
<td><b>${totals[name].total}</b></td>
</tr>`).join('')}
</tbody>
</table>
${S.isAdmin ? `<div class="desc" style="margin-top:10px;"><span class="pill gold">solo admin</span> Leyenda: ${entries.map(n=>`${escapeHtml(map[n])} = ${escapeHtml(n)}`).join(' · ')}</div>` : ''}
${S.isAdmin ? renderVoteDetail(c, d) : ''}
</div>`;
});
return html;
}
